title: Vibrant Roasted Ukrainian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tender beef, fresh basil leaves, and a rich broth, perfect for a cold winter's night. This low-sodium dish is simmered to perfection and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Simmer the stew in the oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the chopped basil leaves and serve hot.
